step_by_step_approach: Gather weekly sales records for the years 2018, 2019, and 2020.
For each year, isolate the four weeks that end on June 14 (the four weeks leading up to June 15).
Sum the sales amounts for those pre‑June 15 weeks for each year.
For each year, isolate the four weeks that start on June 15 (the four weeks following June 15).
Sum the sales amounts for those post‑June 15 weeks for each year.
Compute the percentage change between the post‑June 15 total and the pre‑June 15 total for each year.
Report the percentage change for 2018, 2019, and 2020.
